chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shammun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Misma' ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The nose-ring of the she-camel of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was of silver.

key_terms.بُرَة: Bura - a nose-ring or ring placed through the nostril of a camel for leading it

ai.seo_question: Was the nose-ring of the Prophet's she-camel made of silver?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through a chain reaching Imam al-Sadiq (AS), reports that the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) used a silver nose-ring to lead his she-camel. This detail relates to the permissibility of using silver for animal equipment and reflects the Prophetic practice regarding animal adornment. The ruling is significant in Islamic jurisprudence as it establishes a precedent for the use of silver on animals, in contrast to restrictions on men wearing silver as personal adornment.
